title: WordPress Developer
description: A roadmap for WordPress careers covering site building, themes, plugins, custom post types, performance, security, WooCommerce, and client delivery.

tree.name: WordPress and Web Foundations
tree.description: Learn HTML, CSS, PHP basics, WordPress admin, hosting, domains, themes, plugins, pages, posts, and content workflows.

children.name: Admin and Content Modeling
children.description: Manage pages, posts, categories, menus, media, users, roles, custom fields, and editorial workflows.

children.name: HTML, CSS, and PHP Basics
children.description: Customize templates with semantic HTML, responsive CSS, PHP functions, loops, conditionals, and includes.

tree.name: Theme and Plugin Development
tree.description: Build custom themes and plugins with WordPress hooks, template hierarchy, blocks, shortcodes, and secure settings.

children.name: Theme Development
children.description: Use template hierarchy, functions.php, enqueue scripts, blocks, responsive layouts, and accessibility checks.

children.name: Plugins and Hooks
children.description: Create plugins with actions, filters, settings pages, custom post types, REST endpoints, and secure forms.

children.name: Practice: Custom Content Type
children.description: Create a custom post type with fields, templates, archive page, REST output, and editor instructions.

tree.name: Performance, Security, and Ecommerce
tree.description: Build fast, secure, SEO-friendly WordPress sites and ecommerce stores that clients can maintain.

children.name: Speed and Security
children.description: Optimize caching, images, database, Core Web Vitals, updates, backups, roles, and malware prevention.

children.name: WooCommerce
children.description: Configure products, payments, shipping, taxes, order workflows, emails, and custom shop templates.

tree.name: Client Delivery and Portfolio
tree.description: Deliver maintainable client websites with scope, staging, backups, handoff docs, analytics, and support plans.

children.name: Client Workflow
children.description: Use local/staging/prod environments, Git, backups, migration plugins, acceptance checklists, and handoff videos.

children.name: Project: Business Website with Blog
children.description: Build a custom WordPress site with theme, CPTs, contact form, SEO, analytics, backups, performance report, and client guide.
